channel.title: Backpacking Light Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Backpacking Light Magazine (backpackinglight.com)

item.title: Satellite Messaging Devices ("Messengers") - Backpacking Light
item.description: This gear guide summarizes the category of satellite messaging-centric devices, i.e., devices that focus on satellite messaging as its primary, rather than secondary, function. This is in contrast to navigation-centric devices (which usually offer integrated mapping on the device), such as the Garmin inReach Explorer or Garmin GPSMap.

item.title: Fuel Transfer Valves for Backpacking: Fuel Physics, Myths, Risks, and Real-World Performance - Backpacking Light
item.description: Technical guide to canister fuel transfer devices - how Alpenflow and FlipFuel work, physics, safety limits, and best practices.

item.title: Episode 140 | Winter Storm Decisions - Backpacking Light
item.description: Use a six-question framework to decide whether to stay put or bail when winter storms, terrain, and fatigue raise backcountry risk.

item.title: Episode 141 | Hiking at Night in a Blizzard - Backpacking Light
item.description: Critical winter layering, handwear, footwear, lighting, and navigation systems for safely hiking out through a sub-freezing blizzard at night.

item.title: Staff Picks 2025 - Backpacking Light
item.description: Our staff selects their favorite hiking, backpacking, and other outdoor gear that they’ve used over the past year - the next edition of our infamous Staff Picks!

item.title: Episode 142 | The 72 Hour Backcountry Reset - Backpacking Light
item.description: Why 72 hours in the backcountry delivers lasting mental reset: attention, stress, sleep, and decision-making—plus 24-hour options.

item.title: Flying With Backpacking Gear: TSA, FAA PackSafe, and Airline Rules for Carry-On and Checked Bags - Backpacking Light
item.description: Verifiable U.S. guidance for flying with backpacking gear using TSA “What Can I Bring?”, FAA PackSafe, and airline policies: what’s allowed on aircraft, what must be checked, and key edge cases.

item.title: By The Numbers: Fun Findings For Five Fuzzy Fabrics - Backpacking Light
item.description: Lab data compares Alpha Direct, Primaloft Evolve, and Teijin Octa fuzzy fabrics for MVTR, warmth-to-weight, drying energy, and durability.

item.title: Episode 143 | Managing Fatigue - Backpacking Light
item.description: Managing fatigue in the backcountry using a load-capacity model and practical levers to reduce risk and prevent errors.

item.title: Episode 144 | Trail Steepness vs. Difficulty - Backpacking Light
item.description: How physiology and biomechanics shape hiking effort across terrain - and why slope doesn’t predict time or energy linearly.
